boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Saint Michael’s spaces with documented academic, creative, service, recreation, or community uses.

cards.title: Children’s Collection Room
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Durick Library
cards.notes: Bring independent work or a small study group to this second-floor room, then use its children’s-book collection as a quiet change of scene.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, spacious library room with a children’s-book collection.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael’s identifies the Children’s Collection Room on Durick Library’s second floor as a quiet, spacious place for individual or group focused work.
cards.source_title: A roundup of St. Mike’s study spots
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor of Durick Library; confirm building access and hours before visiting.

cards.title: Writing Center
cards.subtitle: Room 222, Durick Library
cards.notes: Stop in with an assignment idea or draft, choose a focus for the session, and work alongside a trained student writing coach during open hours.
cards.short_summary: A library-based writing workspace with student coaching.
cards.evidence_claim: The Writing Center is in Durick Library Room 222 and welcomes students to use the space for focus or to work with trained student writing coaches.
cards.access_notes: Walk-ins and appointments are offered; consult the Writing Center page for current hours.

cards.entity_name: Center for Student Diversity, Empowerment, and Community
cards.title: DEC in Alliot
cards.subtitle: Center for Student Diversity, Empowerment, and Community, Alliot
cards.notes: Use the couches or study rooms for a work session, and check in with the DEC for student-centered community programming and support.
cards.short_summary: A welcoming Alliot hub with couches and study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael’s says DEC welcomes any student, functions as a hub of student activity, and includes couches and study rooms used for studying.
cards.source_title: A roundup of St. Mike’s study spots
cards.access_notes: Located in Alliot; availability of individual rooms may vary with programming.

cards.entity_name: First Floor of Dion Family Student Center
cards.title: First Floor of Dion
cards.subtitle: Dion Family Student Center
cards.notes: Settle into the first-floor study area when you want a more active setting, and pair your session with a stop at the nearby Makerspace.
cards.short_summary: An active study area beside the Makerspace in Dion.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael’s describes a study area on Dion’s first floor and identifies the Makerspace there.
cards.source_title: A roundup of St. Mike’s study spots
cards.access_notes: The first floor is in the Dion Family Student Center; respect Makerspace and event-area access rules.

cards.title: Durick Library
cards.subtitle: Academic and student-success hub
cards.notes: Start with the research desk or collections, then use the building’s academic-support offices to connect a research task with next-step help.
cards.short_summary: The campus library also houses archives and multiple student-support services.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael’s says Durick Library supports student research and scholarship and houses archives, international services, study abroad, and the Student Success Center.
cards.access_notes: Building hours and access information are published through the library’s hours link.

cards.title: Alliot Student Center
cards.subtitle: Student-engagement and service offices
cards.notes: Look for the MOVE bulletin board on the first floor to learn about volunteer opportunities, or visit the office for program-specific meeting details.
cards.short_summary: A student-center base for MOVE’s community-service programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael’s directs students to the first-floor Alliot MOVE bulletin board for program sign-ups and identifies MOVE’s office as Alliot 124.
cards.access_notes: MOVE sign-ups and meeting locations are program-specific; check the bulletin board or contact the program.

cards.title: Adventure Sports Center
cards.subtitle: Ground floor, Alumni North
cards.notes: Ask about instruction or outings in climbing, paddling, skiing/riding, or mountain biking, and review the specific program’s participation expectations first.
cards.short_summary: A campus program base for outdoor-sport training and outings.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael’s says its Adventure Sports Center offers training and outings in kayaking, climbing, skiing/riding, and mountain biking, and is on Alumni North’s ground floor.
cards.access_notes: Located on the ground floor of Alumni North; activities require program-specific preparation and participation arrangements.

cards.title: McCarthy Arts Center
cards.subtitle: Campus performance venue
cards.notes: Check the campus events calendar for a student-produced performance or arts event, then confirm the venue and entry details for that specific program.
cards.short_summary: A campus arts building used for student-produced performances and events.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael’s identifies McCarthy Arts Center as a site for student-produced performances and as home to the theatre program’s shows and events.
cards.access_notes: Performance access and ticketing, if any, are determined by each event.

cards.title: Tarrant Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Campus fitness complex
cards.notes: Plan a recreation session around the fitness complex’s running track, courts, pool, or fitness center, and verify current facility access before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A recreation-center component of the campus fitness complex.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael’s identifies Tarrant Recreation Center and Ross Sports Center as home to a fitness complex with an indoor track, courts, pool, and fitness center.
cards.access_notes: Facility access and availability may vary; confirm current recreation-center policies before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Robert E. Sutton Fire and Rescue Station
cards.title: Robert E. Sutton Fire and Rescue Station
cards.subtitle: Home of Saint Michael’s Fire and Rescue Squad
cards.notes: View the station from permitted campus areas and learn about the student-run squad through official materials; do not enter operational spaces uninvited.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus station housing Saint Michael’s student-run fire and rescue squad.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Michael’s identifies the Robert E. Sutton Fire and Rescue Station as an on-campus facility housing the student-run Fire and Rescue Squad’s ambulances and fire vehicles.
cards.access_notes: Operational emergency-services facility; exterior viewing only unless the College or squad provides access.
